viewing_check: Photograph the signature and date at full size and compare with known Battarbee signatures (this one reads as neat capitals, not cursive). Take the back off or photograph the verso: the Maud Vizard-Wholohan Art Prize entry label, any Alice Springs or gallery labels, title and provenance. Check for foxing, fading, mount burn and whether it is watercolour or gouache on paper.
